media.vfr_evidence: Original packet PTS in 1/90000 timebase: 970 packets, PTS 0–2910570; 49 distinct positive intervals ranging 2961–3463 ticks (32.900–38.478 ms), versus tick precision 0.011111 ms. Pairwise constant-period model with one-tick rounding is infeasible. Real publisher capture timestamps retained without local FPS manipulation. Modest variability, not coverage of severe cadence switching/frame-drop storms.
